description: This file defines the `SurveyWrapper` class, which provides functionality to render and process survey forms in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving survey questions, responses, calculating statistics, and rendering survey templates using FreeMarker.

classes.name: SurveyWrapper
classes.description: Handles rendering and processing of survey forms, including retrieving questions, responses, calculating results, and template rendering.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator used for database operations.

methods.name: setPartyId
methods.description: Sets the party ID associated with the survey response.

methods.name: setSurveyId
methods.description: Sets the survey ID.

methods.name: checkParameters
methods.description: Validates that required parameters are set.

methods.name: setPassThru
methods.description: Sets pass-through data for hidden form fields.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default values for survey responses.

methods.name: addToTemplateContext
methods.description: Adds an object to the FreeMarker template context.

methods.name: removeFromTemplateContext
methods.description: Removes an object from the FreeMarker template context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey template given a path, returning a Writer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey using a URL and writes output to the provided Writer.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a FreeMarker template from a URL.

methods.name: setEdit
methods.description: Sets whether the survey is editable.

methods.name: getSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves the survey entity for the current surveyId.

methods.name: getSurveyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current survey.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Determines if the survey can be updated based on configuration and survey attributes.

methods.name: canRespond
methods.description: Checks if responses can be submitted for the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyQuestionAndAppls
methods.description: Retrieves the list of survey questions and applications for the current survey, ordered by sequence.

methods.name: getThisResponseId
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent response ID for the current survey and party.

methods.name: setThisResponseId
methods.description: Sets the current response ID.

methods.name: getNumberResponses
methods.description: Returns the number of responses for the current survey.

methods.name: getSurveyResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses for a specific question.

methods.name: getResponseAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves a map of answers for a given survey response.

methods.name: getQuestionResponses
methods.description: Gets responses for a specific question with pagination and transaction management.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Computes and returns statistical results for a list of questions.

methods.name: getResultInfo
methods.description: Calculates detailed results for a specific question, including counts, percentages, averages, etc.

methods.name: getBooleanResult
methods.description: Calculates total yes/no responses for a boolean question.

methods.name: getNumberResult
methods.description: Calculates total, tally, and average for numeric questions.

methods.name: getTextResult
methods.description: Counts responses of text questions.

methods.name: getOptionResult
methods.description: Calculates response counts for option questions.

methods.name: makeEliCondition
methods.description: Creates an entity condition for querying responses to a question.

methods.name: getEli
methods.description: Gets an EntityListIterator for responses to a question.

methods.name: SurveyWrapperException
methods.description: Custom exception class for survey-related errors.
